summary: Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Co filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose its net asset value per share as of June 30, 2026, which was $10.25. This is a routine financial disclosure required for business development companies. No event triggering a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is reported. The filing contains no deal terms, advisor appointments, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. It is purely an informational update with no implications for any special-situation category.
